samples.title: Thói quen đi bộ

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The fact that street design may give little attention to people travelling on foot can create difficulties in the context of walking as a daily habit. For instance, a parent with a pushchair may have to step into the road because the pavement is blocked. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.

paragraphs.label: Giá trị bị bỏ lỡ
paragraphs.text: Another concern is that the potential benefit may not be realised. The original aim is useful because people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip. When the arrangement does not work, people may lose this opportunity as well as the time they have already spent trying to participate. This can make them less willing to try again.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phát triển hệ quả: mất cơ hội và sự tin tưởng.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to keep pavements clear and improve practical walking routes. For example, a local group could identify one important route to the market and report the barriers along it. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, the main problems include the possibility that some routes are difficult to use and that a useful opportunity is lost. paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt vấn đề và giải pháp, không mở ý mới.

samples.title: Dành thời gian cho sở thích
samples.prompt: In the context of making time for hobbies, people may compare their starting point with experienced hobbyists. What problems can this create, and how could they be reduced?

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The fact that people may compare their starting point with experienced hobbyists can create difficulties in the context of making time for hobbies. A useful idea may fail to help the people it is intended for. It is therefore important to examine the practical problems and suggest changes that deal with them directly.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu tình trạng và yêu cầu bàn tác hại.

paragraphs.label: Vấn đề và ảnh hưởng
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that an ambitious hobby plan can become another source of pressure. This matters because expensive equipment and demanding goals may make a beginner feel unsuccessful. For instance, someone may stop practising music after trying to learn several difficult pieces in the first week. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu tác hại với người cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Giá trị bị bỏ lỡ
paragraphs.text: Another concern is that the potential benefit may not be realised. The original aim is useful because a hobby can provide a break from work and routine responsibilities. For example, an office worker can spend one evening each week learning to draw with a small local group. When the arrangement does not work, people may lose this opportunity as well as the time they have already spent trying to participate. This can make them less willing to try again.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phát triển hệ quả: mất cơ hội và sự tin tưởng.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to begin with small goals and choose an affordable way to practise. For example, a beginner could borrow equipment and practise one simple skill for a short time each week. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cách làm trực tiếp giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, the main problems include the possibility that an ambitious hobby plan can become another source of pressure and that a useful opportunity is lost. A response based on practical needs, such as the decision to begin with small goals and choose an affordable way to practise, is more likely to help than simply repeating that the original idea is worthwhile.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt vấn đề và giải pháp, không mở ý mới.
